target_profile.scope: Native Apple-silicon macOS binaries, including required public and Apple-specific extensions and ABI behavior; host extensions selected by explicit capability checks.
target_profile.inventory_limits: Reviewed shared A64 forms only. This list is not a complete Apple CPU feature contract, private-extension inventory, or binary-compatibility denominator.

instruction_sources.redistribution_scope: Only factual identifiers, names, categorical/feature metadata and fixed encoding bits are included. Arm XML, authored instruction prose and pseudocode remain local and are not redistributed.

profile.description: Reviewed ordinary control-flow forms under explicit native block exits and serialized runtime dispatch. GuestState* arrives in RDI; the two-u64 BlockExit next_pc/kind is returned in RAX/RDX. The mapped guest code/address profile is nonwrapping, GCS disabled, executable pages unguarded and ordinary data addresses use private direct RAM. SVC/BRK partially support a precise typed boundary: native kind 5 returns the instruction PC, and immutable source decoding retains kind, imm16 and the preferred exception return PC. Architectural exception entry is pending.
outside_scope: GCS, guarded-page BTI checks and PSTATE.BTYPE
architectural exception delivery and asynchronous state reconstruction
privilege, MMU, devices and full ARM memory ordering
full process ABI, application loading and macOS boot

status_policy: Block and leaf counts are separate profile assessments of canonical forms. Nine forms overlap; counts must not be added. No Apple ISA or compatibility denominator is established.

forms.review: Reviewed ordinary transfer decoding and native BlockExit emission against the linked original-A64/native/Rust-dispatch suite. Smoke binds the first-terminator prefix and ABI; it does not execute the block.
forms.scope: Ordinary control transfer returns the next guest PC and exit kind to serialized dispatch, with X30=PC+4 for calls and original-target capture for BLR X30. Conditional transfers preserve guest NZCV. Guest address arithmetic must not wrap. GCS is disabled and executable pages are unguarded; no PAC, PSTATE.BTYPE or exception delivery is claimed.

forms.review: Exact pinned imm16 encoding and state-preserving trap-boundary emission reviewed against original ARM interrupt observations, independent prefix/state math, raw native tuples and Rust dispatch. Rejection samples check neighboring exception classes, not full exception-delivery semantics.
forms.scope: Partial: stop at the original instruction PC with preserved modeled GPR/SP/NZCV/reserved state, class and imm16. Preferred exception return is PC+4 for SVC and PC for BRK. No EL/PSTATE transition, vector dispatch, ESR/SPSR/ELR register update, syscall service or host trap is implemented. Input code extents remain nonwrapping; leaf compilation declines.
